name: VoiceBench
intro: VoiceBench 是面向LLM语音助手的多维评测基准，平行评估能力与鲁棒性，结合真实和合成口语指令，并对照文本输入与语音输入下的任务表现。
metric: 任务特定指标：GPT-4o-mini 1–5分、PANDA/GPT准确率、选择题准确率、IFEval宽松/严格准确率、拒答率；论文Overall公式未公开
task_type: 语音问答, 语音对话
intro_en: VoiceBench is a multi-faceted benchmark for LLM-based voice assistants. It evaluates capability and robustness in parallel using real and synthetic spoken instructions and compares task performance under text and speech inputs.
scale_en: 5,783 samples across seven capability datasets (636/200/553/455/3,074/345/520); robustness variants reported separately
metric_en: Task-specific metrics: GPT-4o-mini 1–5 score, PANDA/GPT accuracy, MCQ accuracy, IFEval loose/strict accuracy, and refusal rate; the paper's Overall formula is unpublished

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.17196v3, Sections 3.1-3.2, Tables 2-3, and the official repository https://github.com/MatthewCYM/VoiceBench. The paper defines capability and robustness as parallel benchmark components. GPT-4o text normalization, Google TTS, manual correctness validation, rewriting when needed, and the 30-second cap apply to the synthetic path; CommonEval and SD-QA use real speech. Table 3 reports an Overall column, but neither the paper nor the official evaluation code publishes its aggregation formula.. VoiceBench paper-v3 adapts seven capability datasets with 636/200/553/455/3,074/345/520 samples. Capability and robustness are parallel benchmark components. CommonEval and SD-QA use real spoken instructions; the synthetic-only capability path normalizes TTS text with GPT-4o, generates audio with Google TTS, manually checks correctness and the 30-second limit, and rewrites text when needed. Robustness seeds are source-constrained: AlpacaEval supplies speed, age, volume, pitch, environment, content-error, and synthetic-accent variants (with Google/Melo TTS), while SD-QA supplies real-accent speech. Evaluation compares ground-truth text (T.) with speech (S.) and uses task-specific metrics. The paper reports an Overall column, but neither the paper nor official evaluation code publishes the aggregation formula.
